Lina T: Two days out 10: we still need the final speaker blurbs, confirm backup presenter, and lock lead routing thresholds.

Omar V: Speaker blurbs updated here: https://docs.redwood/speakers/apr-briefs. I can be backup for demo if Priya is pulled.

Priya S: Thanks Omar. I'm primary and confirmed. Backup OK. Also I added a short script for the fallback recorded clip and a one-liner for ops to run.

Gabe N: Can someone paste the one-liner? Ops won't dig into docs in a rush.

Priya S: Paste: 
```bash
# swap to recorded fallback clip
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/demo/swap -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"mode":"recorded","url":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/webinar_short.mp4","reason":"demo_fallback"}'
```

Omar V: Lead routing: threshold = 4 signups in any 10min rolling window -> immediate post to #sales-hot-leads + ping @oncall-sales. Else batch to SDR inbox every 30m. Also tag leads with webinar_2026_apr.

SalesBot: [automated] webhook active -> https://hooks.example.com/inbound/webinar-apr-1895. Delivery tests passed.

Lina T: Rehearsal checklist condensed and published: AV join 20m early, mic check, slide sync, run long-tail prompts. Link: https://docs.redwood/rehearsal/checklist.

OpsBot: [automated] health-check scheduled for 2026-05-02T16:40:00Z.

Priya S: Canned line for hallucination: "We're switching to a safe demo while we investigate that response." Keep it brief.

Gabe N: All good from my side. I'll lock the run-of-show and share one-pager for speakers by EOD.

Lina T: Great. Preflight 09:50 PT in #marketing. Please confirm availability.

Omar V: Confirmed.

Priya S: Confirmed.

Gabe N: Confirmed.
